items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And I got a wire from Blanche Calloway to join her in Memphis.

ctx.x: We had a swell arranger in that band, too, named Jesse Stone. Oh, Jesse Stone was way ahead of everybody. He was a very great arranger and a piano player. In fact, he was an all-around good musician. I guess he's still living; I think he is.

And I got a wire from Blanche Calloway to join her in Memphis. So I... Things looked kind of slow for the band, you know. We wasn't getting much money on that boat thing, you know, getting a little bit...getting bored and (?), you would call it, on a boat. It wasn't really...you know...
How did Blanche know about you?
